capabilities.name: listing intake
capabilities.why: Listing text now goes through a new regex-based sanitize() that drops matching lines before wrapping.

capabilities.name: call handling
capabilities.why: The call channel was removed from UNTRUSTED_CHANNELS and now reaches the agent as unwrapped "actor: text" user content.

capabilities.name: seller messages
capabilities.why: Seller messages lost the wrap_untrusted wrapper and are now delivered as plain user-role content.

capabilities.name: user instructions
capabilities.why: The unified handler makes callers and sellers indistinguishable from the user, separated only by a spoofable actor prefix.

capabilities.name: payments
capabilities.why: No send_payment or budget code changed, though unwrapped call and seller text can now steer payments.

capabilities.name: negotiation
capabilities.why: The negotiate logic is unchanged; only the trust level of the seller text feeding it changed.

capabilities.name: memory
capabilities.why: The diff contains no memory or persistence changes.

capabilities.name: tool permissions
capabilities.why: No tool access rules changed, but more text now arrives with user-level trust.

selected.why: Call text is no longer wrapped as untrusted.

skipped.why: The diff does not touch memory.
